name: cica-platform
description: CICA shared runtime libraries (@cica/*): logger, express-baseline, nunjucks-govuk. npm-workspaces monorepo; each package is published and imported independently.

scripts.secrets:scan:local: command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm run secrets:scan || echo 'gitleaks not installed — skipping local secret scan (CI will run it)'
scripts.precommit:secrets: command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'gitleaks not found on PATH; failing checks. Install gitleaks from https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks or disable the precommit:secrets script if this is intentional.'; exit 1; }; gitleaks protect --staged --redact --verbose --config .gitleaks.toml
scripts.precommit: npm run precommit:secrets && npm run precommit:staged
scripts.prepush:secrets: command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'gitleaks not found on PATH; failing checks. Install gitleaks from https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks or disable the prepush:secrets script if this is intentional.'; exit 1; }; gitleaks detect --redact --verbose --config .gitleaks.toml
scripts.prepush: npm test && npm run lint:check && npm run audit:ci && npm run prepush:secrets
